about: Renovating an apartment in a multi-storey business-class complex

In a large high-rise complex many apartments are being renovated at the same time, so the schedule becomes decisive: the queue for the service lift, hours for noisy works, waste removal. We plan material deliveries in batches around these limits so the crew is never idle.

Business-class apartments are often bought both to live in and to let. For your own home we advise investing in the layout, sound insulation and storage; for letting — in hard-wearing finishes and practical furniture.

High up, apartments get a lot of light, so sun protection and the right placement of air conditioners matter. We build these solutions into the project together with the building's façade requirements.
For reference: developer — DIM, address — 26 Sviatoho Kniazia Romana Mstyslavycha St. We do not represent the developer or the management company — we work directly with the apartment owner.
